main_text.p: diit infigne Opus Biblicum Complutense, studio Francisci Ximenii, Archiepiscopi Toletani.

Sequenti anno editum est in Italia Psalterium Octoplum, Hebraice, Græce, Arabice, Chaldaice, cum tribus versionibus Latinis, & commentario ex Hebraïs potissimum Scriptoribus elaborato, per Aug. Justinianum Genuensem, Episcopum Nebiensem.
ANNO Christi M. D. XXVIII. in Gallia Santes Pagninus Lucensis, post Hieronymum primus Biblia Hebraea integra in Latinum fidelissimè convertit.
ANNO M. D. XXXIIII. in Germania Sebastianus Munsterus, & paulo post, Sebastianus Castalio, similiter magnâ fide & diligentiâ Biblia Hebraea Latinè interpretati sunt.
ANNO M. D. XLIII. prodiit Versio Latina Leonis Judæ, Theologi Tigurini, religione & fide summâ elaborata.

ANNO M. D. XLVIII. infecuta sunt Biblia Regia Hispanica, Hebraica, Chaldaica, & Græca, cum totidem Latinis versionibus, studio incredibili, labore & diligentiâ admirabili, ac laude Regis sempiternâ, per Ariam Montanum adornata.
Postremò, viri incomparabiles Immanuel Tremellius & Franciscus Junius, suam quoq;

page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true"). The scan has a small mark at the foot, which is not printed text and is left out. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Several Roman numerals (XXVIII, XXXIIII, XLIII, XLVIII) are read from a slightly blurred scan and should be checked against the original. "Santes" and "Ariam" are as printed as far as legible. The word "Versio-" at the foot is the catchword, and the hyphenated word continues on the next page.
